label: Ensemble Kalman filter on WaterSim (HBV + snow), joint state-parameter
numpy_only_reason: runs the vendored WaterSim kernels (HBV step, degree-day snow) inside a numba-compiled filter loop; numba compiles at first call (~3 s), no cache files written (cache=False). A pure-numpy port would be ~100x slower (daily loop x 32 members x 4,000+ days).

compute.notes: No network training. 0.64 CPU-h tuning filter settings on 250 simulated TRAIN runs (tools/tune.py, ~75 variants, work/tune/*.jsonl) + 0.32 CPU-h rung evaluations (4 rungs + an open-loop diagnostic; 800 sim val runs + 52 dev basins x 3 leads) + ~0.02 smoke tests. One thread, nice 5.

feature_engineering: No learned features. Uses forcing columns P, PET, T_mean; the 11 attributes -> a WaterSim basin spec (elevation bands from mean and range, slope, forest, porosity, ksat, carbonate, urban; aridity and p_mean from the static vector) -> WaterSim's attribute transfer functions for HBV + degree-day snow parameters and the p1 water-yield multiplier prior (elevation, frac_snow, p_mean); observed flow qobs up to the forecast origin (t - lead) is assimilated as log(Q + c), c = 0.02 x p_mean.
rule: keep if sim val median NSE at lead 3 > incumbent + 0.01 AND dev median NSE at lead 3 >= 0.95 x the incumbent's (harness's suggested gauged rule). Filter settings tuned on simulated TRAIN runs only; rung decisions on the frozen sim val set + dev gate.

rungs.change: state-only EnKF: HBV + degree-day snow (WaterSim kernels), attribute-prior parameters (scatter 0.5), p1 water-yield multiplier prior; EnSRF on log(Q + 0.02 P), states in log space; settings tuned on 250 sim TRAIN runs: sigma_P 0.2, sigma_T 1 C, store noise 0.1, obs error 0.3 (log), RTPS 0.9, innovation clip 3 sd, 32 members

+ joint state-parameter estimation: 8 augmented log parameters (precipitation multiplier, FC, BETA, K1, K2, PERC, K0, LP; random walk 0.003-0.005/day) and wider initial parameter spread (scatter 1.0); tuned on sim train
+ UZL augmented and observation offset c 0.02 -> 0.2 x mean P (less weight on low flows; sim-train peaks FHV -14 -> -12 %)
rungs.why: sim val 0.705 (+0.033 > 0.01) but dev 0.488 < 0.95 x 0.528 = 0.502: fails the dev gate

rungs.change: r1 with parameters from agent B's physics-in-the-loop mapping (tab_dpl, registered hash 5a86b90b36cc9ef1: NN attributes -> HBV + snow + CH_VEL + PMULT, trained through WaterSim on the sim bank) instead of WaterSim's attribute transfer functions; same filter settings

diagnostic_openloop.what: r0 settings, no assimilation (prior WaterSim ensemble mean); dev only
